exposure: semi-automated calculation method of fetal body volume
PACS method for fetal weight calculation
outcome: accuracy of MR-EFW (median absolute relative errors)
cohort: The study included 36 patients at 38.6 weeks of gestation prior to planned delivery.
finding: The simplified semi-automated MR-EFW measurement significantly decreased the time of planimetric measurement with a larger gap and in the assisted method compared to the PACS method, without a decrease in the accuracy of weight estimates.
